name: sum the signed cross products of consecutive vertices
mechanism: walk the vertices in order, add each x times the next y and subtract each y times the next x, wrapping at the end; half the absolute total is the area and its sign gives the orientation

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Shoelace algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: determine the area of a polygon whose vertices are described by ordered pairs in the plane
